TextView.android:text: Lesson 1 - Unit 5: Ba, Na, -ng, and More Everyday Words
Placed as the 2nd or last word in a sentence to turn it into a question.
- is a word used as a linker for adjectives, nouns, and phrases. For instance, it links adjectives to what they are describing.
- If the first word ends in a vowel, you can replace 'na' with '-ng' to combine into one word.
